title: Bourke Post Office
scope: The standing 1880 Bourke Post Office with its second storey, filigree verandah and early twentieth-century entrance lobby.
limitations: The state archive image precedes the front lobby. The lobby follows the published state heritage description and its exact offsets are estimated.
Plan dimensions, rear service wing details, finish variations and small joinery are estimated.
The national elevation source resolves river plain grade at approximately 31 metres, so it cannot resolve front steps or the paved footpath.
